record.title: El petó (The Kiss)
record.museum: Museu d’Art de Cerdanyola, Cerdanyola del Vallès, Spain
record.note: Smith’s caricatural kiss joins a sharply bent man and a woman whose body sags in his grasp. The museum’s annotations describe her as inert and passive, giving the embrace an unsettling imbalance. This polychromed plaster, made around 1906, preserves Smith’s rough modeling and muted color. It belongs to the Museu d’Art de Cerdanyola, accession MAC35.
record.source_institution: Giravolt — Agència Catalana del Patrimoni Cultural
record.scan_source: Official Giravolt digitization of museum object MAC35 by Judith Martí. Original polychrome texture retained in the optimized web model.
record.attribution: El petó (The Kiss), c. 1906, by Ismael Smith i Marí. Museu d’Art de Cerdanyola, MAC35. 3D digitization: Judith Martí / Giravolt; interpretive text: Àlex Rebollo. Model released under CC BY 4.0.

license_evidence.license_review: Live public API model metadata and signed-in download dialog both show CC BY 4.0, commercial use allowed. Institutional publisher is linked from the Generalitat Giravolt programme website.
license_evidence.adult_context: Official museum digitization description says man and woman, and annotations consistently identify the two as adult male/female figures. Adult status supported by curatorial language rather than appearance alone.
license_evidence.curatorial_context: Official viewer annotations 3 and 4 call the man grotesque and say he firmly clutches the woman around waist and head. The woman is described as inert/passive, almost as if fainted. Present this as critical art-historical interpretation, not affirmative consensual romance.

record.title: A Moment Before the Kiss
record.note: Two standing lovers draw each other close, their bodies pressed together and faces held just apart. Kangro turns the anticipation of a kiss into a compact granite group. The work forms a pair with A Moment After the Kiss in Tallinn’s Musumägi park.
record.scan_source: Third-party photogrammetry scan made with Polycam, published June 2024, obtained through Sketchfab’s signed-in download control. Atrium cropped the outer grass apron, optimized geometry and resized the original texture. A narrow grass collar and small rear spur remain beside the integral stone plinth; no sculpture surfaces or replacement geometry were added.
record.attribution: A Moment Before the Kiss. Artwork: Tauno Kangro. 3D scan: takac.ondrej; CC BY 4.0. Atrium derivative: outer grass apron cropped, geometry optimized and original texture resized.

record.title: A Moment After the Kiss
record.note: Two kneeling lovers hold one another in a close embrace. Their arms, heads and torsos join into a single compact form above a broad granite base. The work forms a pair with A Moment Before the Kiss in Tallinn’s Musumägi park.
record.scan_source: Third-party photogrammetry scan made with Polycam, published June 2024, obtained through Sketchfab’s signed-in download control. Atrium cropped the surrounding pavement, optimized geometry and resized the original textures. A narrow pavement fringe remains beside the integral stone plinth; no sculpture surfaces or replacement geometry were added.
record.attribution: A Moment After the Kiss. Artwork: Tauno Kangro. 3D scan: takac.ondrej; CC BY 4.0. Atrium derivative: surrounding pavement cropped, geometry optimized and original textures resized.

exhibition_placements.text: Roughly modeled plaster and muted paint give this kiss its uneasy character. Move around the group to see how the folds, grasping hands, and tilted heads are worked into one continuous surface.
